statement: Unlock statues by doing the Town Marble NPC quest line in W1: buy a sculptor tool from the W1 shop and give it to him.
A statue is a rare drop from monsters or resources; it buffs your character, and all characters once the golden sculptor tool is unlocked.
Interact with the Town Marble NPC and drag and deposit statues; each statue levels up for bigger bonuses like base damage, health or mining power.
There are 25 statues as of world 5.
Deposited statues only affect one character until you have the golden statue, which merges the highest-level statue of each character.
Buy the golden sculptor tool at the W2 shop and drop it in front of the Town Marble NPC; he turns gold and a new tab pays money to make statues golden (account bound).
Making statues golden costs money in the new tab and makes them account bound for everybody.
Power statue (base damage) and health statue (base health) are best farmed at W1 or W3 crystal mobs.
Bullseye statue (accuracy %) is best farmed at walking sticks.
Beasty (food effect), Beholder (crit chance) and Speed (boat speed) are best farmed at W1, W2 or W3 crystal mobs.
Lumber Bob (chopping power) is best farmed at W1 crystals and mining nodes.
Mining statue (mining power) is best farmed at W1 crystals or any chopping nodes.
Anvil (production speed), XP book (XP %) and Cauldron (alchemy XP) are best farmed at W2 crystals.
Old Reliable (catching power) is best farmed at W2 crystals and fishing nodes.
Thick Skin (base defense) is best at W2 crystals, specifically the palm trees at the crab cakes map.
EXP statue (skill XP) is best farmed at W3 crystals and the monolith quest.
Kachow is an extremely rare statue rewarding crit damage percent.
Kachow is rewarded by the picnic stowaway daily quest at the frogs map and the monolith quest in W4.
Ocean Man (fishing power) is best at catching nodes.
Box statue (trapping power) is best farmed at W3 sheepies and penguins.
Soul statue (worship power) is best farmed at W3 Sir Stash and quenchies.
Seesaw (construction XP) is best farmed at W3 blobs and chytos snakes?
Pia (monster cache?), Mutton (cooking XP) and Egg (breeding XP) are all best farmed at W4 crystal mobs.
Battle Axe (damage %), Boat (sailing speed) and Spiral (divinity XP) are best farmed at W5 crystals.
For most statues the best places are crystal mobs, best done with the Divine Knight.
For statues dropping from normal mobs like sheepy or quenchies, the Elemental Sorcerer is the best class.
Rule of thumb: anything on the first card page is farmed with the Elemental Sorcerer; rare drop table items are better with the Divine Knight.
Run tons of drop rate when farming statues.
He shows an image of the best card setup for Divine Knight and Elemental Sorcerer.
Hard focus the statue EXP bubble: when levelling statues the XP bar doesn't drop to a certain percent, saving hundreds or thousands worth of statues.
Skinny Zero Cal vial gives a percent chance to double all statue deposits.
The rip bonus Bemy gives every vial a multiplicative bonus per level 13 vial, letting Skinny Zero Cal pass 100% and guarantee double statue deposits.
Voidwalker talent Statue Beautification boosts all statues for every character, unlike other statue talents like Shielded Statues which only affect one.
Statue Beautification at its current max of 245 gives a 110% increase to statue bonuses.
Statue Beautification stacks with other statue talents.
Onyx statue is the most recent and likely final upgrade, giving 2x statue bonus and stackable 10% statue deposit bonus per Onyx statue unlocked.
The monolithic NPC at the Flom beige in W4 gives the Onyx sculptor tool.
First Onyx quest needs 250 statue levels and 17 unique statues, one of each; they aren't consumed so you can transfer them to other characters.
Second quest needs 20K power statues, farmable on your DK at the borne beans map and transferred to other characters; 200,000 in total.
Last quest requires 100K of any statue, done on the character that accepted the quest; the Onyx tool is rewarded at this stage.
If farming the 100K statues on a non-DK character, farm a mining or chopping node with full drop rate, AFK or use time candy.
Drop the Onyx sculptor tool in front of the statue man to unlock Onyx statue; base damage is already upgraded from the quest.
To upgrade other statues to Onyx, drop 20K of that statue in front of the statue man, 24 more times in total.
The 100K statue quest rewards 10,000 kachow statues per character, 80k total, after using 20K to make it Onyx.
Don't deposit the extra kachow statues yet; use only 20K to upgrade to Onyx and bank the rest until all other statues are Onyx.
With all Onyx statues you get a 250% increase to statue deposits; 80k banked statues become 200k plus 80k, 280,000 potency.
With Skinny Zero Cal at 100% doubling, 80k kachow statues become 560,000 worth for a cost of 80,000.
With max Skinny Zero Cal and all Onyx statues you get 7x statue deposits, not including the statue EXP bubble.
